name: Sustainability in Geotechnical Engineering
description: Introduction to sustainability in geotechnical engineering, life cycle assessment of geotechnical projects, impact of construction activities on soil and environment, use of recycled materials in soil improvement, green foundation techniques, sustainable slope stabilization methods, and environmental considerations in geotechnical design.
